info.name: Log Analyzer - Phase 5 (Memory & Conversations)
info.description:
Phase 5 Conversational AI testing collection.

PREREQUISITE: Run Phase 3/4 ingestion first so the agent's tools have data.

Key concept: Each sessionId gets isolated memory. Follow-up questions within the same session remember previous context.

Debugging tips:
- Set breakpoint in ConversationController.chat() to see sessionId routing
- Watch console logs: each request shows the FULL conversation history being sent to OpenAI
- Compare: same question with same sessionId (has context) vs new sessionId (no context)

item.name: Step 1 — Multi-turn conversation (same session)
item.description:
Run these IN ORDER with the SAME sessionId. Each follow-up builds on previous context.

DEBUG: Watch the OpenAI request logs — each subsequent request includes ALL previous messages.

item.name: 1a. Turn 1 — Initial question
item.description:
First message in the session. Memory is empty.
Watch: OpenAI request has only system + this user message.

item.name: 1b. Turn 2 — Follow-up filter
item.description:
Follow-up using 'those'. The agent should remember the errors from Turn 1.
Watch: OpenAI request now has Turn 1's user+assistant messages + this new message.

item.name: 1c. Turn 3 — Pronoun resolution
item.description:
'them' refers to the database errors from Turn 2.
This tests pronoun resolution via conversation memory.

item.name: 1d. Turn 4 — Request action based on context
item.description: The agent should suggest fixes for the database errors discussed in previous turns.

item.name: Step 2 — Session isolation
item.description: Use a DIFFERENT sessionId. This session has NO memory of Step 1's conversation.

item.name: 2a. New session — same follow-up question
item.description:
Same question as 1c ('What caused them?') but in a NEW session.
Without context, the agent won't know what 'them' refers to.
Compare this answer with 1c's answer.

item.name: 2b. New session — independent conversation
item.description: Start a fresh conversation about a different topic in session B.

item.name: 2c. Back to session A — context preserved
item.description:
Return to session A. It should still remember the DB error conversation.
This proves sessions are truly isolated and persistent.

item.name: Step 3 — Compare Phase 4 vs Phase 5
item.description: Same question through Phase 4 (stateless agent) vs Phase 5 (conversational).

item.name: 3a. Phase 4 — Stateless agent query
item.description: Phase 4 agent has no per-session memory. Each request is independent.

item.name: 3c. Phase 5 — Follow-up (turn 2)
item.description: This works in Phase 5 because of memory. Phase 4 can't do this.
